tooltip.lc_hollowforged.worldshard.detai: Fully recovered melee attacks
Wait for the normal attack meter to refill.
Ignore 50%% of the target's armor.
Deal 50%% more damage to blocking targets or targets with 15+ armor.
Disable blocking shields for 5s and knock the target back.
Nearby enemies take 40%% of damage dealt, within 4 blocks.
Fracture the Earth
Tap [%s]; release within 0.6s.
Send a 24-block-long, 7-block-wide shockwave forward.
Deal 40 base damage and knock enemies away.
Apply Shattered for 15s. Cooldown: 30s.
The Last Argument
Hold [%s] for 3s, then release.
Deal 100 base damage within 20 blocks.
Apply Shattered for 30s; stun eligible creatures for 4s.
Cooldown: 5 min.
Releasing between 0.6s and 3s cancels the charge.
Move 80%% slower while holding the charge.
Ability damage is reduced by enemy defenses.
Terms and restrictions
Shattered: the target's effective armor is halved.
Stuns do not affect players or control-immune creatures.
Off-hand actions are disabled while this hammer is held.
